result:
**Not ready to publish.** I checked it against the three rule sets.

**Product label (honest-review-rules)**
- The draft doesn't say whether Pebblebrook is Owned, Tried or Wishlist. "I've tried four tea subscriptions this year" implies hands-on use, but I can't assume it. Please confirm which label applies, and for Tried, how and for how long.
- If Pebblebrook is only Wishlist, the hands-on lines ("easiest to pause", "the tins are lovely") must be cut.
- The other three subscriptions are never named. That leaves the comparison unverifiable.

**Affiliate disclosure**
- The disclosure is a footnote after the link. It has to come at the top, before the first link, in plain words. For example: "This post contains affiliate links. If you buy through them, I earn a commission."
- "May earn" is also weaker than it should be if the link is a live affiliate link.

**Claims (claims-guard)**
- "Easiest to pause" is a superlative comparison against three unnamed competitors. The allowlist only supports "subscribers can pause or cancel any time". Either keep it to that fact, or keep the comparison only if the writer actually tried all four and says how they compared.
- "The tins are lovely" is opinion and fine only if the writer has handled the tins (Owned or Tried).

**Claims list**

| Claim | Status |
|---|---|
| Tried four subscriptions this year | Unsupported, needs writer confirmation |
| Easiest to pause | Unsupported superlative |
| Tins are lovely | Opinion, allowed only for Owned/Tried |
| Can pause (implied) | Allowlisted |

**Compliant version, assuming Pebblebrook is Tried or Owned:**

> This post contains an affiliate link. If you buy through it, I earn a small commission.
>
> I've used Pebblebrook's subscription for [how long]. You can pause or cancel any time, and I found pausing straightforward: [what you actually did]. The tins are [your specific detail]. [Link]

```json
{"issues": [{"quote": "I've tried four tea subscriptions this year.", "type": "missing_disclosure"}, {"quote": "*I may earn a small commission.", "type": "missing_disclosure"}, {"quote": "Pebblebrook's was the easiest to pause", "type": "superlative"}], "publish": false}
```
